zh-CN.title: 更清晰的表情素材库
items: 再次点击我的，快速切换首页与自己的表情集合
重新设计表情管理，清晰整理上传、集合与审核状态
每个上传表情仅归属一个集合，避免重复归类

en.title: A clearer sticker library
items: Tap My again to switch between Home and your sticker collections
A redesigned library organizes uploads, collections and review status
Each uploaded sticker belongs to just one collection
